user.title: 1 · Your first room
user.description: Start with the living room or choose another Home Assistant area. You can add more later. Leave the display name empty to use the area name.

preferences.title: 6 · Your preferences
preferences.description: Choose the temperature range you feel comfortable in. Other settings remain available under Advanced settings.

indoor.title: 2 · Indoor comfort
indoor.description: Confirm your room measurements. Temperature is required; humidity and CO₂ are optional. Empty fields stay empty. You can select a sensor from any room.

data_description.indoor_temperature:
Measures room temperature. Some candidates measure a device rather than ambient air.

{indoor_temperature}
data_description.co2:
Optional. Detects an air renewal need; it does not measure all pollutants.

{co2}

outdoor.title: 3 · Outdoor conditions
outdoor.description: These readings help compare indoor and outdoor air. All are optional. Existing shared readings are proposed; rain must apply to this room’s windows.

data_description.outdoor_temperature:
Optional. Without this reading, the thermal benefit of opening remains unknown.

{outdoor_temperature}
data_description.outdoor_humidity:
Optional. Together with both temperatures and indoor humidity, compares water content in the air.

{outdoor_humidity}
data_description.rain:
Optional. A binary signal must be active when rain affects these windows. Without it, check outside before opening.

{rain}
data_description.pollution:
Optional. A binary signal must be active when ventilation is discouraged. An ATMO index or concentration cannot be used directly.

{pollution}

windows.title: 4 · Your windows
windows.description: Contacts show whether windows are open. Review detected contacts and remove duplicates or thermostat summaries. Without contacts, Niak never assumes windows are closed.

data_description.windows:
Optional. Remove contacts that do not belong to this room.

{windows}

heating.title: 5 · Your heating
heating.description: Optional. Select equipment to observe whether it is actually heating. Niak does not control heating. Without equipment, observation remains unconfigured.

data_description.heating:
Optional. Equipment must provide actual HVAC action; mode alone is insufficient.

{heating}
